run_list_assets_cli: run the fairseq2 assets CLI to list all available model, dataset, and tokenizer assets
run_show_asset_cli: run the fairseq2 assets CLI to show details of a specific asset by name
run_main_entry: run the fairseq2 assets CLI main entry point with argparse subcommands for listing and showing assets
review_ListAssetsCommand: review the _ListAssetsCommand class that retrieves and prints assets grouped by source from the asset store
review_ShowAssetCommand: review the _ShowAssetCommand class that retrieves and prints asset card metadata including base card chain
